facts.source_value: Declared quarterly dividend $0.5925 = $2.37 annualised (57.8% of $4.10), not $2.05. With $2.37 the dossier's own perpetuity gives 5.1% / 6.1%. Perpetual growth above 5% exceeds any sustainable rate; on the programme method (10 years then 3% terminal) implied dividend growth is 7.3% / 8.8% / 11.2% at 7.9% / 8.5% / 9.5%
facts.note: Base dividend growth 5% is worth $52 at 8.5% (7% $61, 8% $66) against $69.80. Restated implied_vs_base = above; INCLUDE-SMALL requires at-or-below, so verdict INCLUDE-SMALL -> WATCH. Sensitivity: only at 7.9% and 8% growth does it approach in_line. 3-year base return (+9.9%) assumes the 17x multiple holds.

facts.source_value: Arithmetic of 4.4% reproduces, but (i) 5.5 mmboe/d from about 4.7-4.8 mmboe/d is a 2.8-3.2% CAGR, not mid-single digit; (ii) buyback accretion is per share and cannot be added to total-firm FCF growth; (iii) EV is divided by levered FCF; (iv) perpetual 4.4% growth is not sustainable. verdict_changes.why: Reverse DDM used D1 $2.05 instead of the declared $2.37 dividend, a perpetual 5-6.6% growth rate, and compared it with a mislabelled '6-8% EPS/dividend' objective (dividend objective is 4-6%). Corrected on the programme method the price needs 8.8% dividend growth for ten years (7.3% at the lowest 7.9% rate) versus 4-6% guided and a payout-capped ceiling of about 6.5%: implied_vs_base is above, which INCLUDE-SMALL does not allow.
